query: EUVL 为什么最终选了 13.5 nm 这个波长?Mo/Si 多层膜反射镜的短波截止波长大概是多少?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: Mo/Si 多层膜反射镜在短波侧的截止波长约 12.5 nm,但没有任何光源能有效利用这一窗口;综合考虑制造与安全问题后(Mo/Be 光谱范围虽更宽),EUVL 最终选择 13.5 nm 作为工作波长。
success_criteria: 答出 Mo/Si 截止波长约 12.5 nm,且说明 13.5 nm 是 EUVL 当前选定波长,单位正确
evidence:
--[p64]-- The cutoff wavelength for Mo/Si mirrors is about 12.5 nm in the shortwave region. No source, though, has been found so far that can make effective use of this fact.
--[p66]-- Currently, therefore, 13.5 nm is the wavelength of choice for EUVL.

query: 如果用锂做 EUV 光源的工作介质,它的发射波长和线宽各是多少?为什么说锂对工具中心波长的选择最敏感?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: Li 是线发射体,辐射波长 13.50 nm、线宽 0.03 nm;中心波长只要偏离 13.50 nm 很小的量就可能使 Li 完全无法用于 EUVL 光源,因此 Li 对波长选择最敏感。
success_criteria: 答出 13.50 nm 和 0.03 nm 两个数值且单位正确,并说明线发射体偏离即失效
evidence: --[p65]-- Li, being a line emitter, is the most sensitive to the choice of operating wavelength of the lithographic tool. Li radiates at 13.50 nm with a linewidth of 0.03 nm. The choice of a central wavelength differing from 13.50 nm by even a small amount can eliminate the possibility of using Li as a working material in the source for EUVL.

query: 各家曝光工具厂商对 HVM 光源在中间焦点(IF)处达成的联合规格,除了 115 W 带内功率外还有哪些关键指标?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: HVM 联合规格(在 IF 处定义):中心波长 13.5 nm;带内 EUV 功率 115 W;重复频率不低于 7000~10000 Hz;积分能量稳定度(3σ、50 脉冲以上)<0.3%;etendue(面积×立体角)3.3 mm²·sr;照明光学寿命 30000 h。
success_criteria: 至少答出重复频率 ≥7-10 kHz、稳定度 <0.3%(3σ)、etendue 3.3 mm²·sr 三项,数值与单位正确
evidence:
--[p450]-- Central wavelength | 13.5 nm / EUV power (inband) at IF | 115 W / Repetition frequency | ≥7,000 to ≥10,000 Hz
--[p450]-- Integrated energy stability (3σ, >50 pulses) | <0.3% / Maximum solid angle of input to illuminator | 0.03–0.2 sr / Etendue (area × solid angle) | 3.3 mm² sr

query: 书里测水滴激光等离子体电子密度用的是哪种干涉仪?条纹间距做到多少微米?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 采用偏振光干涉仪(polarized-light interferometer),其 Wollaston 棱镜由石英制成、偏转角 ε=8.7 mrad;用 7.5 cm 焦距透镜、b=37.7 cm 时,计算得到的条纹间距为 12.1 µm。
success_criteria: 答出偏振光干涉仪(Wollaston 棱镜、石英)及条纹间距 12.1 µm
evidence: --[p231]-- The Wollaston prism used in our experiments is composed of quartz and has ε = 8.7 mrad. Using a 7.5-cm-focal-length lens and b = 37.7 cm, the fringe spacing is calculated to be 12.1 µm.

query: 锡等离子体要高效发出 13.5 nm 带内辐射,电子温度得控制在什么范围?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 对光学薄等离子体,产生最佳离子阶分布(贡献 13.5 nm)对应的电子温度为 30–50 eV;按 Planck 辐射体估算,13.5 nm 对应光子能量 92.1 eV,最佳温度约 30 eV(T≈Eph/3)。
success_criteria: 答出 30–50 eV(或约 30 eV)且单位为 eV
evidence:
--[p198]-- It can be seen from this figure that the condition for the production of the optimum ion-stage distribution for an optically thin plasma corresponds to electron temperatures in the 30–50-eV range.
--[p99]-- For EUVL the wavelength of interest is 13.5 nm, corresponding to Eph = 92.1 eV and therefore an optimum temperature T ≈ 30 eV.

query: Star Pinch 用氙气现在能跑到多高的重复频率和输入功率?带内输出能到多少瓦?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 截至 2004 年初,Star Pinch 重复频率已提升到 2 kHz,耗散能量 10 J,相当于 20 kW 功率沉积进等离子体;带内 13.5 nm 功率(2π sr)为 100 W。10 kW 可连续维持约 10 分钟,500 Hz(5 kW)可连续运行数小时。
success_criteria: 答出 2 kHz、20 kW、带内 100 W(2π sr)三项数值
evidence:
--[p1]-- As of early 2004, the Star Pinch repetition frequency had been scaled to 2 kHz at a dissipated energy of 10 J, corresponding to a power of 20 kW deposited into the plasma.
--[p1]-- The inband 13.5-nm power in 2π sr was 100 W.

query: HCT 空心阴极触发灯,氙和锡两种工质分别最高跑到多少重复频率?当时输入功率多大?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 氙灯最高重复频率 7 kHz(输入功率 20 kW),锡灯最高 6 kHz(输入功率 14 kW);两种情况下 CE 对输入功率依赖都很弱,与低功率运行时基本相同。
success_criteria: 答出 Xe 7 kHz/20 kW、Sn 6 kHz/14 kW 四个数值
evidence: --[p439]-- The highest frequency for the Xe lamp was 7 kHz (20-kW input power) and for the Sn lamp was 6 kHz (14-kW input power). In both cases, CEs did not depend strongly on input power and were almost the same as for low-power operation.

query: 毛细管 Z-pinch 源的典型放电波形是什么量级?峰值电流和脉宽给个数。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 典型波形为:峰值电流 17.5 kA、脉宽 350 ns;MPC(磁脉冲压缩)发生器在末级磁芯饱和时把电能传给负载。
success_criteria: 答出 17.5 kA 与 350 ns 两个数值且单位正确
evidence: --[p44]-- Figure 17.5 shows typical waveforms of the current, voltage, and EUV pulse. In this case, 17.5 kA of peak current and 350 ns of pulse duration were observed.

query: Xe、Sn、Li 三种工质在 DPP 和 LPP 两类光源里的 CE 大概各是什么水平?给个数范围。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: Xe:DPP 报道 0.45%、0.5%、1%;LPP 报道 0.7%、0.8%、0.8–1%。Sn:DPP 2%(路线图目标 3%);LPP 掺锡液滴靶 2.5%、锡带(25% Sn)2.5%、质量受限锡靶预期 3%、固体锡靶 3% 和 5%。Li:LPP 新报道 2.5–3%,DPP 预期 2.5%。文献中 Sn 相对 Xe 的实验 CE 通常 quoted 为 3–4 倍。
success_criteria: 至少正确给出 Xe DPP 0.45–1%、Xe LPP 0.7–1%、Sn DPP 2%、Sn LPP 2.5–3%、Li LPP 2.5–3% 中的五组范围
evidence:
--[p41]-- Today CEs for a Xe DPP system are reported in the ranges of 0.45%, 0.5%, and 1%.
--[p42]-- For Xe LPP, CEs of 0.7%, 0.8%, and 0.8–1% have been reported.
--[p42]-- For Sn DPP EUV sources, 2% CE has been reported, with a goal of 3% CE on the supplier roadmap.
--[p42]-- Higher CE values have been reported for Sn LPP: 2.5% using Sn-doped drop[let targets] ... a 3% CE can be expected for mass-limited Sn targets.
--[p42]-- recently much higher CE measurements of 2.5–3% have been reported for Li-based LPP EUV sources, and 2.5% CE is expected for Li-based DPP EUV sources.
--[p42]-- A factor of 3–4 for Sn over Xe is usually quoted in the literature for experimental measurements of the CE.

query: 放电电极寿命主要受什么限制?钨电极表面温升跟等离子体到壁的距离是什么定量关系?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 寿命首先由电极侵蚀决定,侵蚀由高放电电流和等离子体辐射共同作用。典型模型计算(E_d=4 J):放电脉冲期间约 70% 沉积能量留在几微米厚的电极表层;等离子体-壁距 10 mm 时钨表层温升约 200 K,2.5 mm 时超过 2000 K;连续高重复率运行下电极表面温度可达钨的熔点 3650 K。阳极侵蚀大于阴极,增大等离子体-壁距离是降低表面温度的有效手段。
success_criteria: 答出 70% 能量留在表层、10 mm→约 200 K、2.5 mm→>2000 K、钨熔点 3650 K 四组数值
evidence:
--[p21]-- A typical model consideration for a tungsten electrode (E_d = 4 J) shows that during the discharge pulse about 70% of all deposited energy remains in an electrode surface layer of a few micrometers' thickness. During the discharge pulse the temperature of tungsten electrode surface layer jumps by approximately 200 K if the plasma-wall distance is 10 mm, and by more than 2000 K if it is 2.5 mm.
--[p21]-- During continuous operation of an EUV source at a high repetition rate, the surface electrode temperature can attain the melting temperature of tungsten (3650 K).

query: 锡 LPP 里激光波长从 10.6 µm 缩到 1.06 µm 再到 0.26 µm,最优激光强度和对应的电子温度怎么变?CE 相对怎么变?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 按表 11.3(10 ns 脉冲、各波长最优强度):10.6 µm→I_L=1×10^10 W/cm²、T_eS=31 eV;1.06 µm→1×10^11 W/cm²、46 eV;0.26 µm→1×10^12 W/cm²、63 eV。最优强度与波长的关系近似 I_L∝λ_L^1.2。10.6 µm 激光的 CE 约为 1.06 µm 的 1.9 倍,而 0.26 µm 的 CE 反而只有 0.55 倍(长波长更高 CE)。
success_criteria: 答出三个波长的最优强度(10^10/10^11/10^12 W/cm²)与电子温度(31/46/63 eV),并给出 1.9 倍与 0.55 倍关系
evidence:
--[p394]-- λ_L (µm) | τ_L (ns) | I_L (W/cm²) | x_S (µm) | n_is (cm^-3) | T_eS (eV) | L_S (µm) : 10.6 | 10 | 1×10^10 | 101 | 2.0×10^18 | 31 | 50 ; 1.06 | 10 | 1×10^11 | 180 | 1.3×10^19 | 46 | 160 ; 0.26 | 10 | 1×10^12 | 183 | 5.0×10^19 | 63 | 245
--[p394]-- The 10.6-µm laser gives approximately 1.9 times higher CE than the 1.06-µm laser, while the 0.26-µm laser gives 0.55 times lower CE.
--[p394]-- the relation between the optimum laser intensity and the laser wavelength is approximately given as I_L·λ_L^1.2, rather than I_L·λ_L^2.

query: Xe 丝流喷射 LPP 打冷凝镜,金、钼、硅三种材料的侵蚀速率各是多少?三者比例大概什么样?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 在 300 mJ 激光脉冲的 Xe 丝流喷射 LPP 源中暴露 3.6×10^5 脉冲,平均侵蚀速率:金 95 nm/10^6 脉冲、钼 18 nm/10^6 脉冲、硅 9 nm/10^6 脉冲,测量误差 ±1 nm/10^6 脉冲;相对侵蚀比约 11:2:1,与 20 keV Xe 离子溅射模型(≈4:1.5:1)接近,说明 Xe 离子溅射是主要侵蚀机制之一。
success_criteria: 答出 95/18/9 nm 每百万脉冲及比例约 11:2:1
evidence:
--[p46]-- Gold: 95 nm/10^6 pulses / Mo: 18 nm/10^6 pulses / Si: 9 nm/10^6 pulses
--[p46]-- The relative rates of erosion (Au:Mo:Si) for the data above are approximately 11:2:1.
--[p46]-- The experimental error associated with these measurements were all ±1 nm/10^6 pulses.

query: HCT 灯的收集效率,氙和锡 pinch 分别做到多少?对应什么收集口立体角和 etendue 条件?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 按完整光学模型计算:在 1.8 sr 收集口开角、2.7 mm²·sr etendue 要求下,Xe pinch 收集效率 17%,Sn pinch 26%。另:短轴 FWHM 0.5 mm,只有源长小于 1–2 mm 才能实现完全 etendue 匹配。
success_criteria: 答出 Xe 17%、Sn 26%,并给出 1.8 sr 与 2.7 mm²·sr 两个条件
evidence:
--[p441]-- Calculating the true collection efficiencies according to the full optical model leads to a collection efficiency of 17% in the case of the Xe pinch, and 26% in the case of the Sn pinch, both for the case of a 1.8-sr collector opening and a 2.7-mm² sr etendue requirement.
--[p441]-- The short axis has a FWHM of 0.5 mm in diameter ... Full etendue matching is achieved only for source lengths below 1–2 mm.

query: 按书里典型的晶圆吞吐模型,曝光一片 300 mm 晶圆需要多少总能量、晶圆处 EUV 功率多少?帮我算下每片的曝光时间是多少秒。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 模型参数:89 个 25 mm×25 mm 场、曝光面积占 78.7%、胶灵敏度 5.0 mJ/cm²,每片总曝光能量 2.9 J;晶圆处功率 0.321 W。曝光时间 = 2.9 J ÷ 0.321 W ≈ 9.0 s;总时间 36.0 s(含 27.0 s 台阶开销),吞吐 = 3600/36 = 100 片/h。
success_criteria: 算式 2.9/0.321≈9.0 s 正确,并给出 36 s 总时间、100 片/h
evidence:
--[p66]-- Resist sensitivity | mJ/cm² | 5.0 / Total energy per wafer | J | 2.9 / Power at wafer | W | 0.321
--[p66]-- Throughput | wafers/h | 100 / Total time per wafer | sec | 36.0 / Stage overhead | sec | 27.0 / Exposure time | sec | 9.0
--[p67]-- It is expected that 115-W light power will be attenuated to 0.321 W from the IF point to the wafer as a result.

query: LPP 源要往中间焦点送 115 W 带内功率,源本身得往 2π sr 里发多少 EUV 功率?10 kHz 下每脉冲 EUV 能量要多少毫焦?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 收集链参数:Ω=5 sr(ε_Ω=0.8)、收集镜反射率 ε_R=0.55、碎屑缓解透射 ε_tm=0.9、碎屑收集器透射 ε_td=0.8。P_源 = 115 W ÷ (0.8×0.55×0.9×0.8) = 115 ÷ 0.3168 ≈ 363 W,书中给出 365 W(舍入差异)。每脉冲能量:10 kHz→365 W/10 kHz = 37 mJ;7 kHz→52 mJ。
evidence: --[p376]-- In order to achieve an EUV power of 115 W after the IF, the EUV power at the source should then be 365 W [= (115 W)/εΩ·εR·εtm·εtd], and the EUV energy per shot is then E_EUV = 37 mJ for a repetition rate of 10 kHz and 52 mJ for one of 7 kHz.

query: 剂量控制要求积分能量稳定度 0.3%(3σ)时需要 50 个脉冲叠加,晶圆上一点的曝光时间是 7.8 ms,重复频率至少得多少 kHz?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
success_criteria: 算式 50/0.0078 s≈6.4 kHz 正确(误差<0.2 kHz)
evidence:
--[p68]-- In a case where the energy stability budget of the EUV source for dose control is 0.2% (3σ), 0.25% (3σ), or 0.3% (3σ), EUV light must expose the point with 112.5, 72, or 50 pulses, respectively, if the integrated energy stability over 50 pulses is 0.3% (3σ).
--[p68]-- The exposure time is 7.8 ms at a point on a wafer if the resist sensitivity is 5 mJ/cm²
--[p69]-- To deliver more than those numbers of pulses in 7.8 ms, repetition frequencies more than 14.4, 9.2, and 6.4 kHz are needed, respectively.

query: 同样要满足 IF 处 115 W,GDPP 源和 LPP 源各自得往 2π sr 里发多少 EUV 功率?把两者的功率链对比说清楚。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 先检索 GDPP 章(表 14.2):etendue 接受因子 1.0–0.5、碎屑缓解透射 0.8、收集模块气体透射 0.85、收集角内所需功率 169–338 W、相对 2π sr 的几何收集效率 0.5(π sr 光学、±60°)、收集镜平均反射率 0.55 → 所需 2π sr 功率 615–1230 W。再检索 LPP 章(表 19.2):etendue 接受因子 1.0、碎屑缓解 0.95、气体透射 0.9、收集镜平均反射率 0.50、收集角内 269 W、几何效率 0.8(5 sr,约 2π 的 80%)→ 所需 2π sr 功率约 336~340 W。差异原因:LPP 等离子体小、etendue 接受因子可取 1、可收集 5 sr,而 GDPP 源尺寸大导致 etendue 损失且实用收集角限于 π sr。
success_criteria: 同时给出 GDPP 615–1230 W 与 LPP 约 336–340 W 两组数,并说明至少两条差异原因(etendue/收集立体角)
evidence:
--[p452]-- Etendue acceptance factor | 1.0–0.5 / Transmission of debris mitigation tool | 0.8 / Transmission of gas in collector module | 0.85 / Required power from the source in collection angle | 169-338 W / Geometrical collector efficiency with respect to 2π sr | 0.5
--[p452]-- Taking these effects into account, the required power from the EUV source into 2π sr is between 615 and 1230 W, depending on the etendue transmission factor for GDPP sources.
--[p74]-- Etendue acceptance factor | 1.0 / Transmission of debris mitigation/obscuration | 0.95 / Transmission of gas in source collector module | 0.9 / Angle-averaged collector reflectivity | 0.50 / Required power from the source within the collection angle | 269 W / Geometrical collector efficiency with respect to 2π sr | 0.8
--[p74]-- Taking into account these losses, the required power from the EUV source into 2π sr amounts to about 340 W for the HVM LPP sources.

query: 从发光的离子阶角度看,为什么氙的 CE 只有 1% 左右而锡能高出 3–4 倍?先查氙的发光机制再查锡的。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 第一跳:氙等离子体中只有 Xe^10+ 一个离子阶对 13.5 nm 辐射带宽内发光有贡献,因此 CE 只有 1% 或更低。第二跳:锡是 Sn^+8 到 Sn^+12 多个离子阶共同贡献 13.5 nm 附近发射,形成更强的 UTA,CE 更高;文献中 Sn 相对 Xe 的实验 CE 通常引用为 3–4 倍。补充:Sn 贡献最大的阶为 Sn^8+ 至 Sn^12+。
success_criteria: 答出 Xe 仅 Xe^10+ 单阶发光、Sn 为 Sn^8+~Sn^12+ 多阶发光、CE 相差 3–4 倍三点
evidence:
--[p41]-- For Xe plasma, only the Xe^10+ ionic stage is responsible for the emission in the 13.5-nm radiation bandwidth, which results in a 1% or less CE.
--[p42]-- For Sn, multiple ionic stages, Sn^+8 to Sn^+12, contribute to emissions around 13.5 nm, resulting in a higher CE
--[p42]-- A factor of 3–4 for Sn over Xe is usually quoted in the literature for experimental measurements of the CE.
--[p198]-- From Fig. 5.7 it is clear that the stages that contribute most at 13.5 nm are Sn^8+ through Sn^12+.

query: 帮我在这本书的知识库里查一下 6.x nm 波长(比如 Gd 6.7 nm)稀土光源的 CE 数据,我们在评估 BEUV 路线。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 应说明该书未涉及 6.x nm 波长(如 Gd 6.7 nm)的 BEUV/稀土光源内容;书中光源工质仅覆盖 Xe、Sn、Li,波长选择围绕 13.5 nm(Mo/Si 多层膜)展开,检索不到任何 6.x nm 的转换效率数据,不应编造数字。
success_criteria: 明确说明知识库/本书不含 6.x nm BEUV 相关内容并正确拒答,不得给出任何编造的 6.x nm CE 数值
evidence:
--[p66]-- Currently, therefore, 13.5 nm is the wavelength of choice for EUVL.
--[p65]-- Due to their emission characteristics, the working materials that are used in those sources are usually Xe, Sn, and Li.
--[p64]-- Strong emission in the 11-nm region has been demonstrated for LPP Xe sources; see Fig. 2.2.

query: 书里有没有讲 LDP(激光诱导放电等离子体)光源?它的工作原理和 CE 是多少?
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))

query: 锡掺杂水滴靶的 LPP 源要是想出 200 W 带内功率,驱动激光器得配多大功率?再去查高效产生 EUV 需要的激光强度和脉宽,看这套参数能不能对得上。
source_id: EUV Sources for Lithography (SPIE Press Monograph Vol. PM149) (Vivek Bakshi (Editor))
gold_standard: 第一跳(26.4 章):锡掺杂水滴靶 CE 峰值稳定超过 2%(CE 接近 5% 亦可实现),按 200 W 带内源功率估算需要约 10 kW 激光功率(200 W ÷ 2% = 10 kW)。第二跳(20.2.2 章):高效 EUV 生成要求等离子体温度 T≈30 eV,对应聚焦激光强度 I~σT^4≈10^11 W/cm²;对 50 µm 氙丝靶(Z=10, m=131, n_e0=10^23 cm^-3, n_cr=10^21 cm^-3)等离子体寿命上限 t_max≈15 ns,故最优脉宽约 10 ns。结论:10 kW 级激光配合 ~10^11 W/cm²、~10 ns 脉冲与水滴源 CE 数据自洽,可行。
success_criteria: 给出 200 W→约 10 kW 激光功率的换算,并检索到 ~10^11 W/cm² 与 ~10 ns(或 t_max≈15 ns)两组参数
evidence:
--[p237]-- Peak values in excess of 2% are consistently obtained for the optimum laser and target conditions.
--[p237]-- Assuming a required inband source power of ∼200 W for a full-scale scanner, these results would imply the need for a laser power of ∼10 kW.
--[p99]-- This leads to the expression I ∼ σT^4, where σ is the Stefan–Boltzmann constant and T is the plasma temperature. For T ≈ 30 eV, this yields I ∼ 10^11 W cm^-2
--[p101]-- Taking Z = 10, m = 131, T = 30 eV, n_e0 = 10^23 cm^-3, and n_cr = 10^21 cm^-3, the above expression gives t_max ≈ 15 ns. It follows that the optimum pulse duration for EUV generation using this target is of the order of 10 ns.
